notes.title: Patch - 11th July
notes.content:
- Fixed interaction with Dee when you can start a new game with 9 candles already collected.
- Fixed background graphic disappearing in Medallion Special Stages.
- Added windowed mode. Press 1 or 2 on the title screen.
- Added cheat codes! 
Enter a level, hold CTRL and type THESIX for all Medallions.
Enter a level, hold CTRL and type MAKEMERICH for all 25 coins.
Enter a level, hold CTRL and type ALLGIFTS for all gifts.
